description: A number the source reports as determined for this food.
Present in trace amounts. No source publishes a number for a trace, so amount is empty; it is never 0. Arithmetic may treat it as negligible, and must say so.
No usable number: not analysed, missing (CIQUAL '-'), or present in significant quantities with no reliable amount (CoFID 'N'). Amount is empty; it is never 0.
Below a limit the source states; amount is that limit, an upper bound (CIQUAL '< x').
Taken from another food or another database, or from a label or manufacturer (USDA B*/C*/T/LC*/M* codes; AFCD Borrowed, Imputed, Label Data, Estimated).
Calculated from a recipe or from the food's physical composition.
Calculated from other components with conversion factors, by difference or by concentration adjustment. Every published energy value.
The source published an explicit zero. Distinct from trace and from not_analysed.
